tbesh_html:
1) to bar, lock, bolt
1a) (Qal) to bar, lock, bolt

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to fasten up, i.e. with abar or cord; hence, to sandal, i.e. furnish with slippers
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; also denominative from H5275 (נַעַל)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bolt, inclose, lock, shoe, shut up.
